title: Append a planning conversation message
responsibility: Saves a planning message with the design artifact or approved Change target it actually refers to.

inputs.name: planningMessage.context
inputs.description: Provides the repository root and PlanningApi used to read the current plan and append the message.

inputs.name: planningMessage.draft
inputs.description: Contains the unit and thread IDs, author, text, nullable mode/provider/model/version/image hash, and optional Change details. Null mode is stored as plan; user authors map to Local reviewer and other authors to a provider-named agent or Harness, while the agent reference is included only when both provider and model are present. Change mode requires a current approval for the draft version and defaults an omitted status to requested; artifact references require a matching version/hash image or image-free function, service, or config notes with a null image hash.

examples.author: user
examples.text: The spacing now matches the approved direction.

outputs.name: planningMessage
outputs.description: Resolves to the display message created from the appended record, with its generated UUID, timestamp, and normalized author/provider fields. Its version comes from a matched image or notes reference or the Change target, and its image hash is set only for an image reference.

examples.author: user
examples.text: The spacing now matches the approved direction.

errors.name: Change draft approval mismatch or message write failure
errors.description: A Change draft throws if the plan has no current approval or its approval version differs from the draft version; rejections from readPlan and appendMessage also propagate.
